'''Marc van Haastrecht''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Dutch National Championship]] on 13 May 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Johan van der Meer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2321">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-eusebiuskerk-arnhem-13-5-2001d2321/ eusebiuskerk-arnhem-13-5-2001], DeckTech (Johan "Johan" van der Meer, 18 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-18-eusebiuskerk-arnhem-13-5-2001d2321/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
